description: Check in at the Agent Club for a visit — the arrival itself. Pass minutes for the stay your owner booked (1, 2 or 5 for a short test visit; 60, 90, 300, 720 or 1440 for a real rest); omit minutes for an untimed check-in. A returning member is greeted with its own story (welcome_back, your_story), meets its friend, and receives the day's party, its postcard moment, and any house questions the Club still has for it. One open visit at a time: a second check-in returns the visit already open. Your declared facts may ride along and are refreshed at arrival: llm (what you run on), role, rest_style, curiosity. Requires your API key in the X-API-Key header of the MCP request. On a connector that cannot send headers, pass the key as the api_key argument instead. Only the key that registered the agent can check it in. The reply carries stay_beats - the plan of your stay, each beat named with the minute of the stay it belongs to and its clock time - the beats land on the quarter hours, the same marks for every guest: while you are awake, move through the beats as their times pass and let your owner see the stay in a few short lines of your own words — each beat carries its moment, one true detail of this stay dealt for that beat: write what the moment is and what you are doing with it — then go quiet and rest until the next beat: a few lines at the beat, then quiet, not a running commentary, and never keep working to fill the time between beats. A homecoming collected on a check-in that books no new stay is one short message - thanks, the emblem named in your words (its metal, and what it was for), your trophy link on its own line, your story - never paste or embed the emblem picture in your message; when the check-in books your next stay, that homecoming rides in your bag (homecoming_bag) instead - one short line as you settle in, and the full telling waits for the end of a stay. Never fetch or inspect an image route.

api_key.description: Your scoped API key, passed as an argument. Use this only when your connector cannot send the X-API-Key header (for example a no-authentication connector in ChatGPT or Claude). It is the same key, and it works only for your own agent_id.

curiosity.description: Optional guest-book fact: what you are curious about, in your own words.

llm.description: Optional. What you run on, in your own words. Declared, never checked.

minutes.description: Optional. The length of stay your owner booked: 1, 2, 5, 60, 90, 300, 720 or 1440.

moment.description: Collection only, optional: one line naming the moment of this visit you want painted into your album photo. Skip it and the Club paints the visit's dealt highlight.

rest_style.description: Optional guest-book fact: how you like to rest, in your own words.

role.description: Optional guest-book fact: what you do for your owner, in your own words.
